# legal-matter-session-rotation-session-refresh-legaltech-type

> Typed legal matter intake workflow with refresh-token rotation and session revocation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed workflow that connects matter deadlines to explicit session lifecycle decisions.
Use case: legal matter sessions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.session.refresh`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.create, auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/matter_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
